radiusSource: Radius 99.1 +/- 8.2 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, V340 Ara: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 99.1 +/- 8.2 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 68,943,870 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
